sentences.en: It is not ethical for a doctor to reveal confidences.
sentences.zh: 医生泄露病人隐私是不道德的。

sentences.en: He revealed the secret to her when nobody was by.
sentences.zh: 他没人的时候把秘密告诉了她。

sentences.en: Who is able to reveal the mysteries of the sea?

senses.zh: 揭示，透露；表明，证明；展示，显示；（通过神或超自然手段）启示
（电视节目最后的）揭示；门侧，窗侧

mnemonic: 联想记忆：re（相反）+veal（看作veil，面纱）→揭开面纱→揭露，展现
